directions.name: Spectrum
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity, buildable desktop UI concept board for Hermes Studio, a personal bots-first AI workspace.
HARD USER DIRECTION: CLEAN PURE WHITE BACKGROUND WITH VIBRANT COLOR. Apple-like clarity, SF Pro-like modern sans-serif typography, confident generous whitespace, refined native macOS/iOS controls and exceptionally precise visual alignment. The entire board and 90% of interface surfaces MUST be neutral pure #FFFFFF. Use #F5F5F7 only for very small neutral separators/fields. No colored ambient wash or background gradients. No beige, cream, tan, oatmeal, sepia, lavender, violet or purple anywhere. No dark mode. All primary pages, sidebars, cards and chat canvases are bright white. Strong #1D1D1F text. Vivid saturated color is concentrated in avatars, selected navigation items, buttons and small icons; it must be genuinely vibrant, never muted pastel. Do not use Apple logos, app names or copied proprietary characters.
INPUT REFERENCES: Image 1 actual Hermes Studio Bots screen; Image 2 actual Echo Profile; Image 3 actual Echo chat. Use them ONLY to understand features, content, hierarchy and navigation. Completely discard their current purple-tinted backgrounds, glass haze, dark rock avatars, heavy chrome and typography. This is a new aesthetic direction, not recoloring the screenshots. Keep Hermes Studio as the product name and the real four bot names/roles. These are original designs inspired by the refinement of Apple software.
COMPOSITION: landscape board around 3:2, high resolution and razor-sharp text. White edge-to-edge outer canvas. Small top title "Hermes Studio" and concept number/name; no marketing slogan. Three separate straight-on application screens on a rigorously aligned grid, all white, very subtle neutral hairlines and soft realistic small shadows. LEFT, about 62% width: large desktop BOTS screen with a slim native navigation sidebar and an attractive 2x2 grid of four modest white bot cards. RIGHT upper: CHAT screen focused on Echo with a compact friendly welcome. RIGHT lower: Echo PROFILE screen. Small unobtrusive screen captions. Bottom narrow identity row: the four avatars, named Atlas, Nova, Scout, Echo, with a 28px icon next to each large 70px example. Avoid oversized mascot hero art; this is software that people work in, not a character poster. Keep whitespace functional and proportions realistic.
EXACT PRODUCT CONTENT: Main sidebar small "Hermes Studio" brand, search, "Dashboard", "Bots", "Team rooms", "Routines", "Settings", compact team list. Page "Bots", description "Your AI teammates.", button "+ New bot", filter "All 4" / "Ready". Four cards: "Atlas" / "Chief of staff"; "Nova" / "Creative partner"; "Scout" / "Research analyst"; "Echo" / "Writing partner". Each has a different vivid original avatar, textual "Ready" status, short role copy, understated "Chat" action. Main avatars are 64-88px, not huge full body figures. Chat header "Echo", "Writing partner", "Ready"; compact Echo avatar above "Say hello to Echo", starters "Plan my week" and "Shape an idea", composer "Message Echo…" with attach/microphone/send. Profile "Echo", "Open chat", tabs "Overview", "Brain", "Memory", "Files", simple summary sections "How Echo works" and "Capabilities". Details should be quiet, not a dense wall of technical controls. No fake task outcomes, charts, unread counts, inventions of account information or error text.
AVATARS: a coherent original family with four clearly distinct silhouettes, consistent per named bot across every panel. Small friendly dark level eyes, subtle expression, professional companion personality, no angry slant, hood, black face visor, orange glowing eyes or armor. Distinguishable at 28px. No baby proportions, blushing cheeks, kawaii faces, doughy pastel blob mascots, plushies, human bodies, shoes or props. Sophisticated colorful designed objects with understated character. All characters isolated directly against white or a tiny clear icon tile.
Quality target: premium shippable native productivity software, crisp hierarchy, beautiful saturated accents, restrained glass only where useful. Neither a generic SaaS dashboard nor an illustrated brand moodboard. White stays WHITE.
DIRECTION 01 / SPECTRUM. Most Apple-like, luminous and precise. Vibrant electric blue #007AFF primary, vivid coral #FF4F57, spring green #32D45B and rich orange #FF9F0A identity accents. White SF Pro-like interface, very slight clear-glass floating toolbar, clean rounded-rectangle buttons, fine neutral card borders. Selected Bots item a small saturated blue pill with white icon/text. All cards otherwise white. Large confident black page title. Original minimal four-color H brand mark.
AVATAR FAMILY: small polished optical-glass prisms with rounded edges, LIGHT transparent uncolored exterior and a saturated solid colored core, calm dark eyes visible over the core. Atlas is a rounded blue rectangular prism; Nova a coral rounded triangular prism; Scout a spring-green low curved wedge; Echo an orange ring-shaped optical prism. Curved silhouettes, controlled refraction, no sharp shards, no milky pastel tint. Vivid color cores read clearly at tiny size. Product renders comparable to finely made consumer hardware on white, never crystalline fantasy.

refinements.prompt:
Edit this Hermes Studio concept board. Preserve the whole board composition, pixel layout, bright white backgrounds, saturated blue/red/green/orange colors, all text, cards, navigation, buttons, spacing and every non-avatar detail. Change ONLY the avatar facial treatment consistently everywhere it appears.
Atlas, Nova and Scout currently have a black inset face panel and bright white glowing eyes. REMOVE every black face panel/visor completely. Replace with two small simple charcoal oval eyes sitting directly on their translucent saturated colored material. Their calm friendly level eyes must look like the Signal concept's simple direct eyes, with no rectangular or triangular dark face patch, and no white glowing eyes. No scowl, no alien pupil.
Echo currently looks like a single cyclops eye inside its orange ring. Remove the single eyeball and the black pupil completely. Keep the same vivid rounded orange ring silhouette, but put TWO small calm dark oval eyes side by side directly on its orange front surface, plus at most a tiny subtle relaxed smile. The center of the ring remains transparent white, not an eyeball or black hole face. Do this consistently in the card, the large chat welcome, the profile, sidebar portraits and the footer sizes. Keep every avatar color and outer shape exactly as-is; only fix the faces. Sophisticated friendly designed objects on a clean Apple-like white interface. No beige or purple.
